title: room.invite
description: Bring somebody else into the call's room. A second SIP leg dialed to a number is the warm path: the agent stays on with the caller while the other side answers. Lands as participant.joined when they arrive, or error when they do not.

kind.description: sip: dial the number in to as a second leg of the same room; they join with kind sip. participant: admit the identity named in to, for a supervisor's or a listener's seat.
